info.title: Funes Vault API
info.description: Privacy-first personal memory API for users, LLM clients, and MCP integrations.

funes_vault_session.name: funes_vault_session
funes_vault_session.description: HTTP-only session cookie established by Google sign-in.

client_bearer.description: Client bearer token returned at client creation or rotation.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for interpreting dates in this source turn.

submissionId.description: Stable client-generated turn ID, unique per user. Retries reuse the accepted source and thread. Different text with the same ID returns 409.

startNewThread.description: Create a fresh persisted thread as part of accepting this message. Must not be combined with sessionId.

message.example: What do you know about how I like to work?

disclosure.example: When configured, chat sends the current message and retrieved memory snippets to OpenAI.

processing.description: Durable memory processing status, run/source IDs, processors, and saved/queued/pending outcomes.

content.example: Your vault says you prefer concise technical help with concrete next steps. [1]

answer.example: Your vault says you prefer concise technical help with concrete next steps. [1]

lastMessagePreview.example: We captured your preference for concise implementation help.

prompt.example: How do you like AI assistants to collaborate with you?

answer.example: I prefer direct implementation when intent is clear.

text.example: Remember to ask the dentist about the retainer next visit.

captureId.description: Client-generated idempotency key. Re-sending the same captureId returns the existing suggestion instead of creating a duplicate, so offline queues can retry safely.

capturedAt.description: When the capture was originally taken, for captures queued offline and synced later.

deduplicated.description: True when the captureId matched an existing capture and no new suggestion was created.

purpose.description: Caller-declared audit reason; does not affect permissions or retrieval.

body.example: The user prefers local-first tools for privacy-sensitive workflows.

evidence.example: Observed in the active coding session.

statedPurpose.description: Caller-declared audit reason; does not grant permissions.

body.example: The user prefers focused coding help with concrete file changes.

policySummary.description: The app’s single permission set, including expired permissions, in client lists.

oauthConnector.description: True when this client is an OAuth connector grant.

text.example: Prefers concise technical answers: The user prefers concise answers.

purpose.description: Caller-declared audit reason; does not affect permissions or retrieval.

task.example: Help the user modify a local repository

revision.description: Required for approval; use the preview revision.

memoryIds.description: Required for approval; select one or more previewed memory IDs.

description.example: Coding tools, languages, workflows, and preferences.

body.example: The user prefers concise, direct technical answers.
The user prefers concise, direct technical answers.
The user prefers concise implementation when intent is clear.

sessionId.description: Existing chat thread to continue by voice. Omit to start a new thread.

startNewThread.description: Force a fresh thread even when sessionId is provided.

value.description: Ephemeral Realtime client secret. Short-lived; the provider API key never reaches the browser.

disclosure.example: Voice sessions stream your microphone audio and any retrieved memory text to the OpenAI Realtime API and receive synthesized speech back.

sessionId.description: Chat thread the voice transcripts persist into.

sourceItemId.description: Finalized user Realtime item ID that owns the extraction result. Missing or not-yet-persisted sources return pending for capture tools.

toolCallId.description: Realtime function call id, echoed into tool traces.

output.description: Tool output to return to the Realtime model.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for interpreting dates in this source turn.

itemId.description: Stable Realtime item ID. Duplicate delivery reuses the message; changed content is rejected.

content.example: Your vault says you prefer concise answers, so I kept it short.

citations.description: Citations gathered from request_memory calls in this turn.
